research_rationale:
EO 12990 of February 29, 1996 (Adjustments of Rates of Pay and Allowances for the Uniformed Services, Amendment to Executive Order No. 12984), read in the held Federal Register text (61 FR 8467, Federal Register of March 5, 1996; machine-extracted text layer). Identity: number, date and subject agree with the census register row (1996-02-29). Sec. 1 adjusts the rates of monthly basic pay, basic allowances for subsistence and quarters, and cadet or midshipman pay for the uniformed services as set out on the attached schedule; Sec. 2 makes the adjustments effective January 1, 1996; Sec. 3 supersedes section 4 and Schedule 8 of EO 12984. Note on completeness: pages 2 to 4 of the held text layer (the attached schedule) contain only page headers and a filing line, so the schedule tables are not in the held representation; Sec. 1 incorporates the schedule, and its life follows Sec. 1 and Sec. 2. EO 13033 (signed 1996-12-27; 61 FR 68987, Federal Register of December 31, 1996) supersedes this order expressly in its Sec. 7, which names it. Under the owner's amendment ruling (2026-10-21), Sec. 3, a partial supersession of EO 12984 that works together with the replacement schedule in Sec. 1, continues while this order stands. Searches: the dossier's three machine searches (U.S. Code release point 119-121, current through 2026-10-09; eCFR point-in-time search as of 2026-10-14 with GovInfo CFR bulk XML; Federal Register executive-order catalog disposition notes and operative sentences of 17,521 saved order texts) were chosen after reading their coverage notes, which carry no scope warning. Machine hits for this order: current-law:usc 0, current-law:ecfr 0, later-events:ofr_catalog 1. The packet's by-number scan of held order texts (LOOKUPS) was read for this order; held texts citing this number are its own text and EO 13033, the superseding order.
